mentions.description: This open-source molecule viewer and editor is written in Rust and is gaining drug-development features and polish. Its building blocks are split into separate libraries published on crates.io for anyone building other bio or chem software.
mentions.audience: Developers building other bio or chem software (for the split-out libraries)
